draft_quote: we call the family complete when $K_{\mathsf G}=\mathcal H_\Phi$
evidence_or_owed: The space generated from the ground by the words of a family and their adjoints is defined, and completeness is equality with the whole space. The centered vectors span the generated space minus the ground line for every family. On the five-site path a union of incomplete families is complete.

clause: Difference of reordered words on the ground
evidence_or_owed: The difference of the two orders on the ground is the commutator on the ground. The text adds that different vectors can lie on one ray, as for anticommuting Pauli matrices, and that different pure states can agree on every available effect, so a claim about what can be distinguished needs the distinguishing effects.

clause: Exhausted profile's generators and adjoints reduce the ground line
draft_quote: LG calls a profile with this property exhausted.
evidence_or_owed: The hypothesis that every generator and its adjoint keep the ground line is stated, with its equivalence to commutation with the ground projection, and given LG's name. An example shows that without the adjoints the generated algebra need not keep the line.

clause: Ground preservation of every exhausted word and one-dimensional generated space
evidence_or_owed: Every element of the generated C*-algebra commutes with the ground projection and acts on the ground by a scalar, so the generated space is the ground line. The family generated by the path Hamiltonian is an example in which the site algebra still makes the ground cyclic.

clause: Equality of restrictions to a selected content algebra
evidence_or_owed: Content equivalence is equality of the restrictions to the chosen algebra, decided by its effects. The text identifies it with the readout relation of Section 5, gives the two path states as an example, and shows that a unitary preserves every restriction to the algebra exactly when it commutes with it, while it can change the restriction to a second algebra.

clause: Selection of object-content and affective subalgebras
draft_quote: Which algebras represent object content and which represent affect in a realization is open.
evidence_or_owed: Stated as open, with the remark that the relation is defined for every choice and that states equivalent for one choice can be distinguished by another.

clause: Character of the exhausted profile's represented algebra
evidence_or_owed: The scalar is the vector state of the ground, it is multiplicative and preserves adjoints, centered elements annihilate the ground, and the cyclic representation is one-dimensional. The text adds that the state is pure and faithful only on the scalars.
